item.tib: zab don rin chen phreng ba las thod phreng sde lnga'i lo rgyus
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni lcags pho stag gi lor gnas chen mu d+ham nas zab gter rin po che spyan drangs nas/ lo bcu yi bka' rgya yol te/ dbu tsam phab pa las 'phro lus nas yod pa la/ shar rdza'i rtogs ldan rin po che bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis zab gter mtha' phyung dgos kyi bka' nan byung tshe/ bstan gnyis gsang sngags gling pas dben pa'i ri sul du phab pas yig ge pa ni 'bum rmad g.yung drung bstan 'phel gyis bgyis pa dge'o//
